import sympy as s,json,time,resource,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from itertools import combinations
start=time.perf_counter()
th=s.sqrt(6)*s.I
X=s.symbols('h x y z w');Y=s.symbols('c a b u v')
M=s.Matrix([[2,-6,6,3,-3],[3,-18,18,6,-6],[0,-3*th,-3*th,2*th,2*th],[0,-3*th,-3*th,th,th],[11,-54,54,18,-18]])
lam=-th/36
T=s.zeros(5)
source=json.load(open('reports/MPS_SMOOTHING_COMPLETION_20261103_v62/T37.json'))
loc={f'x{i}':X[i] for i in range(5)};loc.update({k:s.Integer(1) for k in ['p0','t0','t1','t2','t3']})
for key,value in source['homogeneous_bivector'].items():
 i,j=map(int,key.split(','));T[i,j]=s.sympify(value,locals=loc);T[j,i]=-T[i,j]
K=s.zeros(5)
raw=json.load(open('reports/CLASSIFICATION_K4A_ORDER_TWO_ZERO_LOCUS_20261108.json'))['generic_actual_brackets']
locK=dict(zip(('c','a','b','u','v'),Y))
for key,value in raw.items():
 i,j=map(int,key.split(','));K[i,j]=s.sympify(value,locals=locK);K[j,i]=-K[i,j]
Minv=M.inv();N=M*s.Matrix(X);InvX=Minv*s.Matrix(Y)
compose=lambda p,old,new:s.expand(p.subs(dict(zip(old,new)),simultaneous=True))
Q=M*T*M.T
Diff=s.zeros(5)
for i,j in combinations(range(5),2):
 Diff[i,j]=s.expand(Q[i,j]-lam*compose(K[i,j],Y,N)); Diff[j,i]=-Diff[i,j]
triv={}
for i,j,k in combinations(range(5),3):
 triv[f'{i},{j},{k}']=s.expand(N[i]*Diff[j,k]-N[j]*Diff[i,k]+N[k]*Diff[i,j])
assert all(a==0 for a in triv.values()),[(k,v) for k,v in triv.items() if v!=0]
DY=s.zeros(5)
for i,j in combinations(range(5),2):
 DY[i,j]=compose(Diff[i,j],X,InvX);DY[j,i]=-DY[i,j]
W=[s.expand(sum(s.diff(DY[i,j],Y[i]) for i in range(5))/5) for j in range(5)]
Euler=s.zeros(5)
for i,j in combinations(range(5),2):
 Euler[i,j]=s.expand(DY[i,j]-(Y[i]*W[j]-Y[j]*W[i]));Euler[j,i]=-Euler[i,j]
assert all(a==0 for a in Euler)
def F(P,Z):
 ans=0
 for i in range(5):
  a,b,c,d=[j for j in range(5) if j!=i]
  ans+=(-1)**i*Z[i]*(P[a,b]*P[c,d]-P[a,c]*P[b,d]+P[a,d]*P[b,c])
 return s.expand(ans)
FT=F(T,X);FK=F(K,Y)
Pf=s.expand(lam**2*compose(FK,Y,N)-M.det()*FT)
assert Pf==0
packet={'task_id':'E_reduced_nonnormal','all_passed':True,'source':'completed T37 p0=t0=t1=t2=t3=1, coordinates(h,x,y,z,w)','target':'integer K4a actuale1, coordinates(c,a,b,u,v)','coefficient_field':'QQ(theta),theta^2=-6','theta':str(th),'matrix_source_to_target':[[str(a) for a in row] for row in M.tolist()],'determinant':str(s.simplify(M.det())),'inverse':[[str(s.simplify(a)) for a in row] for row in Minv.tolist()],'lambda':str(lam),'literal_identity_direction':'M * P_T37(X) * transpose(M) = lambda * P_K4a(M*X) + (M*X) wedge W(M*X)','Euler_W_in_target_coordinates':dict(zip(map(str,Y),map(str,W))),'all10_projective_trivector_identities_zero':True,'all150_raw_quadratic_coefficients_with_Euler_gauge_zero':True,'matrix_inverse_both_products_identity':M*Minv==s.eye(5) and Minv*M==s.eye(5),'all126_actual_Pfaffian_coefficients_covariant':Pf==0,'Pfaffian_identity':'lambda^2*F_K4a(MX)=det(M)*F_T37(X)','actual_source_Pfaffian':str(FT),'actual_target_Pfaffian':str(FK),'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'input_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ['reports/CLASSIFICATION_K4A_ORDER_TWO_ZERO_LOCUS_20261108.json','reports/MPS_SMOOTHING_COMPLETION_20261103_v62/T37.json']},'inline_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('/tmp/k4a_t37_map_verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(packet,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('ALL PASS det',packet['determinant'],'scalar',packet['lambda'],'seconds',packet['seconds'],'RSS',packet['RSS_KiB'],flush=True)
print('W=',W,flush=True)
